notes: §1985:XV.3.2.4 GR6: identifier-1 alone runs the section before a WRITE/REWRITE that references it, after each PERFORM phase that references it, and after a statement that "explicitly references and causes the content of the data item referenced by identifier-1 to be changed". DebugTriggerPlanner.PlanLeaf asks BoundStores.DirectStoreOf for the store and marks it WhenStored, which DebugTriggerEmitter.Emit/StoreFlagFor clear when a SIZE ERROR path skipped it; the witness is MOVE 5 TO W-X. Probes at 85 (dbg/g6): DISPLAY Y, MOVE Y TO Z, INSPECT GY TALLYING and MOVE to the containing group do not fire; MOVE, INSPECT REPLACING, UNSTRING INTO, INITIALIZE and ADD in an IF fire after; WRITE FROM GY fires before the I-O; READ INTO GY fires when the record moved and not when AT END ran; PERFORM VARYING Y fires on init, test and augment; PERFORM UNTIL Y fires on each evaluation.

next.reason: 1985: "When identifier-1 is specified without the ALL REFERENCES OF phrase, that debugging section is executed at each of the following times"; 2023: "No candidate covers USE FOR DEBUGGING on identifiers; candidates only cover implicit moves, PERFORM sequencing and general USE selection.". None of the candidates covers when a debugging section runs for identifier-1. The 2023 standard lacks the Debug module's identifier debugging, so the requirement is dropped.
